title: Customer and item posting fields read-only preflight
purpose: Inspect U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 posting, VAT and inventory-related fields read-only before any O2C/P2P document, Preview Posting or Posting.
entryCriteria: TARGET-040 rechecked SAAR-HL, U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100/STK read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.

acceptanceCriteria: The run stays in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 are opened or inspected read-only.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-040 proved U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100/STK as visible read-only records but not their posting/VAT/inventory field readiness.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: O2C/P2P documents still depend on concrete posting/VAT/inventory fields. TARGET-042 reads those fields without changing anything.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: The read-only field preflight now gives the exact visible/missing field signals for the next fit decision.
O2C still needs an explicit fit decision before documents are safe.
Vendor creation remains parked; this customer/item preflight does not solve U-VEND numbering.
Chart of Accounts remains a useful cross-check before setup claims are promoted.

queueChangesMade: TARGET-042 completed as read-only field preflight.
TARGET-043 selected as the next narrow fit decision before O2C/P2P.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It converts field visibility/missing signals into a controlled decision instead of creating documents too early.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not edit customer or item fields without a TARGET-043 Smart Decision.
Do not claim posting readiness from visible labels.
Keep Preview Posting and Posting locked.
requiredPreparation: If fields are missing because FastTabs or personalization hide them, run UI discovery instead of writing.
If setup fields are visible but blank, name exact fields and intended values before any write.
